description: This source file defines API route handlers for analysis-related endpoints using FastAPI, including operations such as retrieving analysis status and results, acknowledging suggestions, canceling an analysis, and listing user analyses.

methods.name: get_analysis_status( analysis_id: int = Path(..., alias="id"), repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends() )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the status and overall score of a specific analysis.

methods.name: get_analysis_results( analysis_id: int = Path(..., alias="id"), analysis_repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends(), findings_repo: FindingRepository = Depends(), suggestions_repo: SuggestionRepository = Depends(), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch full results, including findings and suggestions, of a completed analysis.

methods.name: acknowledge_suggestion( analysis_id: int = Path(..., alias="id"), suggestion_id: int = Body(..., embed=True) )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to acknowledge a specific suggestion related to an analysis.

methods.name: cancel_analysis( analysis_id: int = Path(..., alias="id"), repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends() )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to cancel an ongoing analysis.

methods.name: get_user_analyses( user_id: int = Path(..., alias="userId"), repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends() )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all analyses associated with a specific user.
